question: After Rev 9 pair-FOK printed zero fills, what honest taker confirm still beats ghost snapshot fills without going back to assumed fills?
why_rev9_was_too_tight: Crypto up/down CLOB sets itode=true: live takers are held 250ms then revalidated. Beating an 80–200ms MM requote is impossible. Only holes that persist ≥250ms with size are takeable.
Rev 9 required the full snapshot size at frozen limits. 26.6 shrinking to 8 still +EV was killed. Live default taker is FAK, not all-or-nothing FOK of the hunt size.
If the ask ticks 0.82→0.83 and 0.83+the other leg is still +EV after 7% fees, frozen-limit FOK kills. A live bot requotes on the delayed book.
Hunt sized to full book depth / $25 then all-or-nothing on that VWAP. Mixing junk levels can reject a real 5–10 share +EV prefix.
A 5s quote_cooldown on FOK kill blocked retries on the same 5m slug in the last minute.

rev10.first: FAK leftover +EV size at the original snapshot limits if ≥ min_shares and net>0 with gross≥min_edge or tail.
rev10.then: If limits are gone, hunt() the delayed HTTP books (requote). No second 250ms wait: that would model requote+itode and miss 300–400ms sticky holes. Slightly optimistic vs a live requote that eats another itode; still honest vs snapshot ghosts.
rev10.hunt: plus_ev_fill binary-searches the largest prefix in [min_shares, max_shares] that stays +EV after fees.
rev10.still: maker_window=0, min_edge=0.02, FORCE_PAPER, no live, no paper reset

four_rev8_fills_under_rev10.rev10: FAK ~10 if that size is still on the delayed book at ≤0.82; else requote if the new pair is +EV; else kill
FAK at 0.2408 likely empty; requote at 0.27+0.68=0.95 is +EV if that book is still there after 250ms; otherwise kill
still kill unless a delayed book actually exists
kill unless the delayed pair is still +EV

honest_expectation: Rest-state ATM books stay ask_sum≥1.01 and taker_net negative. Rev 10 converts sticky partial size and 1-tick-worse holes into fills. It does not restore Rev 8 snapshot ghost PnL. Dashboard 影/成/殺 still means snapshot would have booked / confirm credited cash / confirm killed.
do_not: credit snapshot fills without the delayed-book confirm while taker_fok is on
